description.name: Entry
description.text: Restores HP (105), removes KO [Raise: 100%], grants [Earth Quick Cast 4] to all allies, grants [Attach Earth], [Synchro Mode], [Damage Cap +10000] and [Gentle Maiden Mode] to the user

description.name: Gaia's Gospel
description.text: Three single attacks (3.10 each), restores HP (17.50/20/25) to allies if 0-1/2-3/4+ allies have any Attach Earth

description.name: Earth Quick Cast 4
description.text: Cast speed x2.00 for Earth attacks

description.name: Attach Earth
description.text: Replaces Attack command, increases Earth damage dealt by 50/80/120% (abilities) or 80/100/120% (Soul Breaks), Earth resistance +20%

description.name: Gentle Maiden Mode
description.text: Casts Oerba's Gift after using Gaia's Gospel or Gaia's Tidings, removed after triggering four times

description.name: Synchro Mode
description.text: Replaces the Attack and Defend commands
